read.thesis: Record Q1 sales and EBITDA with CPG organically down 1.7% on polyol shortages and school/healthcare slowdown; FY27 sales and EBITDA guidance narrowed lower to mid-single-digit growth as raw material inflation rises to 9–11% in Q2.

triggers.label: FY27 sales guide cut to mid-single digit
triggers.quote: We are narrowing our fiscal 27 sales growth to mid single digit growth from our previous outlook of 3% to 7%.

triggers.label: Q2 inflation 9–11% vs 6–8% prior
triggers.quote: we now expect second quarter inflation will be in the 9% to 11% range up from our previous estimate of 6% to 8%.

triggers.label: Q2 price increases 2.5–3.5%
triggers.quote: I would expect price in Q2 to be somewhere in the 2.5% to 3.5% range.

triggers.label: Polyol shortage now resolved in production
triggers.quote: The shortage issue is now behind us in terms of production, but we are catching up on inventory in Q2.

guidance.quote: We are narrowing our fiscal 27 sales growth to mid single digit growth from our previous outlook of 3% to 7%.
Adjusted EBITDA is now expected to grow mid single digits compared to a previous outlook of up 5% to 10%.

guidance.value: low to mid single digit growth
guidance.quote: We expect consolidated sales to increase in the low to mid single digit range
we now expect second quarter inflation will be in the 9% to 11% range up from our previous estimate of 6% to 8%.
For the third quarter, we anticipate inflation will be 7% to 9%

prior_guidance_check.quote: We are narrowing our fiscal 27 sales growth to mid single digit growth from our previous outlook of 3% to 7%.
Adjusted EBITDA is now expected to grow mid single digits compared to a previous outlook of up 5% to 10%.

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 100 bps, guidance cut
red_flags.quote: gross margins declined 100 basis points as the rate of raw material inflation outpaced pricing MAP benefits in the quarter.

red_flags.label: CPG bad debt and warranty charges
red_flags.quote: CPG Bad Debt Expense -- $4.4 million, related to a customer bankruptcy during the period.

evasions.quote: Not at this point in time.
